title: Understanding Your Order Tracking & Statuses
content:
This document outlines how customers can track their ShopEase orders and provides detailed explanations of common order statuses. Customers can track their orders by navigating to the 'My Orders' section on the ShopEase app or website after logging in. Each order will display a unique Order ID and a 'Track Order' button, which provides real-time updates.

Key Order Statuses Explained:
*   **Order Placed:** The order has been successfully submitted and acknowledged by ShopEase.
*   **Processing/Confirmed:** Your order has been received by our warehouse and is being prepared for dispatch. This includes quality checks, packaging, and labeling. Typically takes 12-24 hours.
*   **Shipped/Dispatched:** Your order has left our warehouse and is en route to the local delivery hub. A tracking number (AWB) from our logistics partner is usually generated at this stage, which can be used on the carrier's website for more detailed tracking.
*   **In Transit:** Your package is currently moving between logistics hubs or is on its way to your city. Updates here might be less frequent depending on the carrier's scanning points.
*   **Out for Delivery:** Your package has reached the local delivery hub in your area and is assigned to a delivery executive for final delivery to your address. Customers typically receive an SMS notification at this stage.
*   **Delivered:** Your order has been successfully delivered to the specified address. An SMS confirmation is sent upon delivery.
*   **Delivery Attempt Failed/Customer Unavailable:** The delivery executive attempted to deliver the package but couldn't complete it, possibly due to the customer not being available, address issues, or refusal. Customers will usually receive an SMS with options to reschedule.
*   **Returned to Origin (RTO) Initiated:** After multiple failed delivery attempts or customer refusal, the package is being returned to the ShopEase warehouse. For prepaid orders, a refund process will be initiated upon successful return to our facility.
*   **Cancelled:** The order was cancelled by the customer or ShopEase due to various reasons (e.g., item out of stock, payment failure). Prepaid orders will be refunded.

For any discrepancies or lack of updates for more than 48 hours in 'Shipped' or 'In Transit' statuses, customers should contact ShopEase Customer Support with their Order ID.

title: Estimated Delivery Timelines & Managing Delays
content:
This document outlines ShopEase's standard estimated delivery timelines and procedures for managing potential delays. ShopEase strives to deliver products efficiently across India, but delivery times can vary based on location, product type, and external factors.

Standard Delivery Timelines (Business Days):
*   **Metro Cities (Tier 1 like Bengaluru, Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai):** Typically 2-4 business days.
*   **Tier 2 & 3 Cities (e.g., Jaipur, Lucknow, Kochi, Pune):** Typically 4-7 business days.
*   **Remote Locations/North East India/Jammu & Kashmir:** Can take 7-12 business days, depending on pincode serviceability and logistics partner routes.

These timelines are estimates and are calculated from the moment the order is shipped, not from the time the order is placed. The estimated delivery date is prominently displayed on the product page, during checkout, and in the 'My Orders' section.

Factors Causing Delays:
*   **National/Regional Holidays:** Public holidays, festivals (Diwali, Eid, Christmas), or regional observances can extend delivery times.
*   **Adverse Weather Conditions:** Heavy rains, floods, fog, or extreme temperatures can impact transport and local delivery operations.
*   **Political Unrest/Local Restrictions:** Bandhs, strikes, or localized lockdowns can severely disrupt logistics.
*   **Unforeseen Logistics Issues:** Breakdowns, network issues with logistics partners, or high volume during sales events.
*   **Incorrect/Incomplete Address:** Delays can occur if the customer's address is unclear or missing crucial details.

Managing Delays:
If an order is delayed beyond the estimated delivery date, customers will generally receive an SMS/email notification from ShopEase or our logistics partner. Customers can also check the 'Track Order' section for updates. If an order status has not updated for more than 48-72 hours post-shipping or has exceeded the maximum delivery timeframe by 3-5 days, customers are encouraged to contact ShopEase Customer Support. Our team will investigate with the logistics partner and provide a resolution within 24-48 hours. In rare cases of significant delays where product delivery becomes unfeasible, ShopEase reserves the right to cancel the order and issue a full refund for prepaid orders.

title: Missed Deliveries, Rescheduling & Multiple Attempts
content:
This document outlines ShopEase's policy regarding missed deliveries, the number of delivery attempts, and options for rescheduling. Our goal is to ensure successful delivery while managing logistics efficiently.

Delivery Attempts:
ShopEase, through its logistics partners, typically attempts delivery 2-3 times for each order. The number of attempts may vary slightly depending on the logistics partner and the specific pincode's operational policies.

What Happens After a Missed Delivery Attempt:
1.  **Notification:** After a failed delivery attempt (e.g., customer unavailable, premises locked, address not found), the customer will receive an SMS and/or email notification. This notification will usually include the reason for the failed attempt and instructions on how to proceed.
2.  **Rescheduling Option:** The notification will often provide a direct link or contact number to reschedule the delivery for another convenient time within the next 24-48 hours. Customers can also attempt to contact the delivery executive directly if their number is provided.
3.  **Next Attempt:** If the customer does not reschedule, the logistics partner will generally make a second delivery attempt on the next business day.

Important Considerations:
*   **Contact Information:** It is crucial for customers to ensure their registered mobile number and email address are current, as all delivery-related communications are sent to these contacts.
*   **Address Accuracy:** An accurate and complete address, including landmarks, is vital to avoid delivery issues.
*   **COD Orders:** For Cash on Delivery (COD) orders, repeated failed attempts might lead to the order being cancelled and returned to our warehouse. In some instances, for subsequent attempts, the logistics partner might require a verification call or even a partial upfront payment to confirm customer intent.

Return to Origin (RTO) Policy:
If all delivery attempts (typically 2-3) are unsuccessful, or if the customer explicitly refuses delivery, the order will be marked as 'Returned to Origin' (RTO) and shipped back to the ShopEase warehouse. For prepaid orders that are RTO'd, a refund will be processed upon successful return and inspection of the item at our facility, typically within 5-7 business days of the RTO status being confirmed. Shipping charges, if applicable, might not be refunded for customer-initiated RTOs (e.g., refusal without valid reason).

title: ShopEase Standard Return Policy
content:
ShopEase is committed to ensuring customer satisfaction. Our Standard Return Policy allows customers to return most eligible items within 7 calendar days from the date of delivery. For our ShopEase Plus members, this window is extended to 10 calendar days for most categories. To be eligible for a return, the item must be unused, unwashed, and in its original condition with all tags, labels, and packaging intact. All original accessories, manuals, and freebies received with the product must also be returned. A valid proof of purchase, such as the original invoice or order confirmation, is mandatory for processing any return request.

Certain product categories are exempt from our return policy due to hygiene reasons, nature of the product, or other specific conditions. These include:
*   Innerwear, lingerie, socks, and swimwear.
*   Perishable goods like food, flowers, and gourmet items.
*   Digital products, gift cards, and services.
*   Jewellery, watches, and items customized to customer specifications.
*   Products marked as "Non-Returnable" on the product page (e.g., specific electronics, health supplements).
*   Items that have been used, altered, or are not in their original saleable condition.

All returned items undergo a thorough quality check at our warehouse. Returns will be processed only if the item passes this quality inspection. If a returned item fails the quality check, it will be reshipped back to the customer, and no refund will be issued. The return window begins on the day the item is successfully delivered to the customer, as per our logistics partner's delivery confirmation. Customers are encouraged to inspect products upon delivery.

title: How to Initiate a Return & Pickup Process
content:
Initiating a return on ShopEase is a straightforward process designed for customer convenience. To begin, log in to your ShopEase account on the mobile app or website and navigate to the "My Orders" section. Select the specific order containing the item you wish to return. Click on the "Return" button available next to the eligible product. You will then be prompted to select a reason for the return from a predefined list. Providing detailed comments and, if applicable, uploading clear images of the product (especially for damaged or defective items) helps expedite the review process.

Once your return request is submitted, our system will typically verify eligibility based on the product category and return window. Upon approval, you will be guided to schedule a convenient pickup date and time slot. Our logistics partner will attempt to collect the item from your registered address within 2 to 4 business days from the scheduled pickup date. Please ensure the item is securely packed in its original packaging, including all original accessories, user manuals, and the original invoice. Hand over the product to our pickup agent, who may perform a preliminary check of the item's condition and packaging.

In cases where our logistics partners do not service your specific pin code for reverse pickups, a "Self-Ship" option will be provided. Customers opting for self-shipment must send the item to the designated ShopEase warehouse address (which will be provided upon request approval) using a reputable courier service. Please retain the courier receipt as proof of dispatch. ShopEase will reimburse self-shipment costs up to a maximum of ₹100 upon successful receipt and quality check of the returned item. If a pickup attempt fails due to customer unavailability or packaging issues, you may be able to reschedule via the app or by contacting ShopEase Customer Support.

title: ShopEase Refund Policy & Timelines
content:
ShopEase processes refunds promptly once the returned item successfully passes our quality inspection at the warehouse. The mode and timeline for your refund depend on your original payment method:

*   **Prepaid Orders (Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking, UPI, Wallet)**: Refunds for these payment methods will be credited back to the original source account. The refund typically reflects in your bank or card statement within 5 to 7 business days from the date of refund initiation. Please note that bank processing times can vary, and it might take slightly longer for some financial institutions.
*   **Cash on Delivery (COD) Orders**: For COD orders, refunds are processed via bank transfer. Customers will be required to provide valid bank account details (Account Holder Name, Account Number, IFSC Code, Bank Name) through the ShopEase app/website or by contacting customer support. Once the details are verified, the refund will be processed, and the amount will reflect in your provided bank account within 7 to 10 business days.
*   **ShopEase Wallet Credit**: In some cases, or upon customer request, refunds may be issued as ShopEase Wallet credit. Wallet refunds are usually instant or credited within 24 hours of initiation and can be used for future purchases on ShopEase.

Please note that shipping charges incurred during the original purchase are generally non-refundable, except in cases where the product received was defective, damaged, or incorrect. If a returned item does not meet our quality check criteria (e.g., used condition, missing parts, damaged), the return will be rejected, and no refund will be issued. The item will then be reshipped to the customer.

In the rare event of a refund delay beyond the specified timelines, please contact ShopEase Customer Support with your Order ID and the Refund Reference Number (if available). We will investigate the matter with our payment partners to resolve it swiftly. ShopEase aims for transparency and efficiency in all refund processes to ensure a seamless customer experience.

title: Failed Online Payments & Refund Process (UPI, Cards, Wallets)
content:
This document outlines the policy and process for handling failed online payment transactions where the customer's account has been debited but the order was not successfully placed on ShopEase. 

**Scenario 1: Money Debited, Order Not Placed**
If a customer attempts an online payment (UPI, Credit/Debit Card, Net Banking, or Digital Wallet) and their bank account or wallet is debited, but the ShopEase order status shows 'Payment Failed' or the order was not generated, it indicates a payment gateway reconciliation issue. In most such cases, the amount is automatically reversed by the payment gateway or the customer's bank.

**Automatic Refund Timelines:**
*   **UPI:** Refunds are typically processed within 3-5 business days. The amount is reversed to the original UPI-linked bank account. 
*   **Credit/Debit Cards & Net Banking:** Refunds usually take 5-7 business days to reflect in the customer's bank statement. This timeline includes processing by the payment gateway, the acquiring bank, and the customer's issuing bank.
*   **Digital Wallets (e.g., PayTM, PhonePe, OlaMoney):** Refunds are generally quicker, appearing in the respective wallet within 24-48 hours.

**Customer Actions & Escalation:**
1.  **Wait for Automatic Reversal:** Advise customers to wait for the specified timelines as most issues resolve automatically. 
2.  **Check Bank/Wallet Statement:** Instruct customers to thoroughly check their bank account statement or wallet transaction history for the reversal. They should look for transactions with the same amount from ShopEase or the payment gateway partner (e.g., Razorpay, PayU).
3.  **Provide UTR/Transaction ID:** If the refund is not received within the stipulated period, customers must provide the Unique Transaction Reference (UTR) number for UPI transactions, or the RRN (Retrieval Reference Number) / Transaction ID for card/net banking payments. This ID is crucial for ShopEase's finance team to trace the payment with the gateway partner and the customer's bank.
4.  **ShopEase Support Action:** Upon receiving the UTR/Transaction ID, create a high-priority ticket. The finance team will initiate a manual trace with the payment gateway. Resolution for manual traces can take up to 10-15 business days, depending on bank cooperation. Customers should be informed that ShopEase does not hold the funds in these scenarios; they are stuck with the payment gateway or the banks involved.

title: Cash on Delivery (COD) Policy and Restrictions
content:
This document details ShopEase's Cash on Delivery (COD) payment policy, eligibility criteria, and common restrictions. COD allows customers to pay for their order in cash at the time of delivery.

**Eligibility for COD:**
1.  **Pincode Availability:** COD is available only for select pincodes served by our logistics partners. Customers can check COD availability on the product page by entering their delivery pincode.
2.  **Order Value Limit:** The maximum permissible order value for COD is ₹20,000. For orders exceeding this amount, customers must opt for online payment methods.
3.  **Product Type Restrictions:** Certain high-value products (e.g., premium electronics, precious jewelry), perishable goods, or products requiring special handling may not be eligible for COD. This is indicated on the product detail page.

**COD Restrictions and Scenarios for Unavailability:**
*   **High Return Rate:** Customers with a history of a high number of returns or failed COD deliveries might have COD temporarily disabled for their account. This is a system-generated restriction to mitigate operational losses. 
*   **Specific Seller/Warehouse Policy:** Some third-party sellers on ShopEase or certain warehouse locations may not offer COD for specific items due to their internal logistics or risk management policies.
*   **Promotional Offers:** Certain discounts or promotional schemes might be exclusive to online payments and hence, COD might not be available for orders using such offers.
*   **Number of Pending COD Orders:** Customers might be restricted from placing new COD orders if they have multiple unfulfilled COD orders currently active.

**Process at Delivery:**
*   Customers are required to pay the full order amount to the delivery executive at the time of receiving the package. 
*   The package cannot be opened for inspection before payment. This is a strict policy to ensure the integrity of the delivery process. If a customer insists on opening, the executive should politely decline and explain the policy. If the customer refuses payment, the order will be marked as 'Refused' and returned to the origin.
*   Delivery executives carry change, but customers are encouraged to keep the exact amount ready to facilitate a smooth transaction.

title: Payment Gateway Errors & Troubleshooting for Online Payments
content:
This document provides guidance on common payment gateway errors encountered during online transactions (UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets) on ShopEase and outlines troubleshooting steps for support agents and customers.

**Common Error Messages & Their Meanings:**
1.  **'Transaction Failed' / 'Payment Declined':** General error, often due to incorrect payment details, insufficient funds, or bank-side issues.
2.  **'Declined by Bank':** Indicates the customer's bank has rejected the transaction. Reasons include incorrect OTP, card blocked, daily transaction limits exceeded, or fraud prevention mechanisms.
3.  **'OTP Timeout':** The One-Time Password (OTP) was not entered within the stipulated time, or an incorrect OTP was entered multiple times.
4.  **'Gateway Error / Technical Glitch':** Suggests an issue with the payment gateway or ShopEase's integration, often temporary.
5.  **'Invalid Card Details':** Incorrect card number, expiry date, or CVV entered.

**Troubleshooting Steps for Customers (Advised by Support):**
*   **Verify Details:** Double-check all payment information (card number, expiry date, CVV, UPI ID/VPA) for accuracy.
*   **Check Balance/Limits:** Confirm sufficient funds are available and that daily/transaction limits set by their bank or wallet provider have not been exceeded (e.g., daily UPI limit often ₹1 Lakh).
*   **Try Again:** For 'Gateway Error' or 'Technical Glitch', advise waiting 5-10 minutes and attempting the transaction again.
*   **Alternative Payment Method:** Suggest trying a different payment method (e.g., if card fails, try UPI or Net Banking). ShopEase allows users to retry payment with a different method from the 'My Orders' section.
*   **Clear Browser Data:** Advise clearing browser cache and cookies, or trying a different browser/device, especially for persistent 'Gateway Error' issues.
*   **Contact Bank/Wallet Provider:** For 'Declined by Bank' or persistent 'Transaction Failed' issues, the customer should contact their bank or wallet provider directly to understand the specific reason for denial. This is often the quickest resolution.

**ShopEase Support Action:**
*   Verify if the payment attempt created a pending order or if it completely failed. 
*   If the issue persists across multiple attempts and payment methods, escalate to the technical team, providing the customer's user ID, browser details, and exact error messages encountered for investigation into potential system-wide issues.

title: Password Reset and Account Recovery Policy
content:
This document outlines the standard procedures and policies for users experiencing password issues or requiring account recovery for their ShopEase accounts.

**Standard Password Reset:**
Users can reset their password via the "Forgot Password" link on the ShopEase login page or within the app. This process typically involves:
1.  Entering the registered mobile number or email ID associated with the account.
2.  Receiving a One-Time Password (OTP) on the registered mobile number via SMS, or a secure password reset link via email.
3.  Entering the OTP on the provided field or clicking the secure link to set a new password. The OTP is valid for 10 minutes.
Users are advised to check their spam/junk folders for email OTPs and ensure their registered mobile number has active network connectivity for SMS OTPs. In case of non-receipt, users can request a resend after 60 seconds.

**Account Lockout Policy:**
For enhanced security, if a user attempts to log in with an incorrect password 5 consecutive times, their account will be temporarily locked for 30 minutes. During this period, no further login attempts can be made using that account. After the lockout period, the user can try again or use the "Forgot Password" option immediately.

**Compromised Account Recovery:**
If a user suspects their account has been compromised (e.g., unauthorized purchases, changed personal details), they must:
1.  Immediately attempt to reset their password using the standard "Forgot Password" option.
2.  If unable to access their account or if suspicious activity persists, contact ShopEase Customer Support immediately via the 24/7 helpline or the "Help & Support" section.
3.  Support will initiate a stringent verification process requiring details such as recent order IDs (within the last 3 months), specific payment methods used, the registered full name, date of birth, and any other relevant information to confirm identity.
4.  Upon successful verification, the account will be secured, suspicious activity investigated, and access restored within 24-48 hours. Users will be strongly advised to enable Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) for future security.

**Support-Assisted Account Recovery:**
In scenarios where a user has lost access to both their registered mobile number and email ID, or if standard reset methods fail repeatedly, ShopEase Customer Support can assist with manual recovery. This requires a comprehensive verification process, which may include:
*   Providing at least two recent order IDs and their approximate dates.
*   Details of the payment method used for those orders (e.g., last 4 digits of card, UPI ID).
*   Full name, date of birth, and any alternate contact information provided during initial registration.
*   A scanned copy of a government-issued ID proof (e.g., Aadhaar, PAN) may be requested in extreme cases to prevent fraudulent access.
The full recovery process via support can take up to 72 hours, depending on the complexity of verification and response times for additional information from the user.

title: Updating Personal and Contact Information Policy
content:
This document outlines the procedures for ShopEase users to update their personal and contact information associated with their accounts, ensuring data accuracy and secure management within the platform.

**Self-Service Updates:**
Users can conveniently update most of their personal information by logging into their ShopEase account and navigating to the "My Account" section, then selecting "Profile" or "Manage Addresses." All self-service updates are subject to real-time validation.
*   **Name:** Can be updated once every 90 days. For significant changes (e.g., legal name change), a support ticket with a scanned copy of a valid government-issued ID proof (e.g., Aadhaar, PAN card) may be required to prevent misuse.
*   **Shipping Addresses:** Users can add, edit, or delete multiple shipping addresses. Changes reflect immediately and are available for new orders.
*   **Gender, Date of Birth:** Can be updated directly by the user. Changes are instant.
*   **Email ID:** To change the primary email ID, a One-Time Password (OTP) will be sent to the *new* email ID for verification. The change will take effect only after successful OTP validation. This ensures the new email is accessible and valid.
*   **Mobile Number:** Changing the primary mobile number involves a Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) process. An OTP is first sent to the *old* mobile number for initial verification, followed by another OTP to the *new* mobile number for final confirmation. This robust process safeguards against unauthorized contact detail changes.

**Support-Assisted Updates:**
If a user loses access to their registered mobile number or email ID, making self-service updates impossible, they must contact ShopEase Customer Support. This process requires stringent identity verification.
*   **Process:** The user will need to provide strong identity verification details, which may include recent order details (order IDs, approximate dates, payment methods used, delivery addresses), full name, date of birth, and potentially government-issued ID proof.
*   **Verification:** Support agents will cross-verify the provided information with existing account data. This process is crucial to prevent unauthorized changes and protect user data.
*   **Timeline:** Once verification is successful and all required information is provided, the requested changes (e.g., updating the primary mobile number or email) will be processed within 24-48 hours. A confirmation notification will be sent to the newly updated contact detail.

**Important Considerations:**
*   Keeping contact information updated is critical for receiving timely order updates, refund notifications, security alerts, and OTPs. ShopEase is not responsible for missed communications or issues arising from outdated user information.
*   Changes to primary contact details (mobile number, email) will affect login credentials and notification preferences for all future communications.
*   For ShopEase Seller accounts, specific verification processes apply for business-related information updates, often requiring business registration documents and GSTIN verification.

title: Account Deactivation and Data Retention Policy
content:
This document outlines the policy and procedures for deactivating or permanently closing a ShopEase user account and the subsequent data retention practices in accordance with legal and operational requirements.

**Requesting Account Deactivation:**
Users wishing to deactivate their ShopEase account must submit a formal request through the "Help & Support" section in the app/website, navigating to "Account Management" and then selecting "Deactivate My Account." A specific form will guide the user through the process.
*   **Pre-requisites for Deactivation:**
    *   All pending orders must be completed (delivered, returned, or cancelled).
    *   No ongoing returns, refunds, or warranty claims.
    *   ShopEase Wallet balance must be zero. Any remaining balance (e.g., cashback, gift card balance) must be fully utilized or withdrawn (if applicable) before the deactivation request can be processed.
    *   No active ShopEase Plus/Premium or similar subscription memberships; if active, the membership will be terminated without a pro-rata refund for the remaining period.
*   **Verification:** For security, the user will be asked to confirm their identity via an OTP sent to their registered mobile number or email ID, or through a series of security questions.
*   **Processing Time:** Once all prerequisites are met and identity is successfully verified, the account will be marked for deactivation within 48 hours. A confirmation email will be sent upon successful deactivation.

**Implications of Account Deactivation:**
*   Loss of access to order history, wishlists, saved addresses, personalized recommendations, and any saved payment instruments.
*   Inability to log in or make purchases using the deactivated account.
*   All associated loyalty points, ShopEase Coins, or rewards will be permanently forfeited.
*   For ShopEase Seller accounts, a separate, more rigorous deactivation process is followed, requiring adherence to specific seller agreements and financial reconciliation.

**Account Reactivation:**
A deactivated account can be reactivated within 30 days of the deactivation request by contacting ShopEase Customer Support and undergoing identity verification. Beyond 30 days, the account is permanently closed, and a new registration with a different email/mobile number will be required to utilize ShopEase services. Reactivation of a permanently closed account is not possible.

**Data Retention Policy:**
Upon account deactivation or permanent closure, ShopEase adheres to strict data retention guidelines to comply with legal obligations and operational necessities:
*   **Transactional Data:** Information related to orders, payments, returns, and refunds (e.g., order IDs, product details, payment records, delivery addresses) will be retained for a period of up to 7 years from the date of the last transaction. This retention is mandatory for compliance with Indian tax laws, financial regulations, and audit requirements.
*   **Personal Identifiable Information (PII):** Essential PII (e.g., name, contact details, KYC documents if submitted) directly linked to transactional data will be retained for the same 7-year period to support legal and regulatory obligations.
*   **Non-Essential PII:** Data such as browsing history, wishlists, saved preferences, communication logs not tied to transactions, and profile pictures will be anonymized or permanently deleted from active systems within 90 days of permanent account closure.
*   **Legal Compliance:** ShopEase reserves the right to retain certain data for longer periods if mandated by law, for ongoing investigations, fraud prevention, or to enforce its terms and conditions, even after the specified retention periods. This policy ensures user privacy while complying with all applicable legal and operational necessities.

title: General Product Warranty Policy Overview
content:
ShopEase primarily acts as a marketplace facilitator, and the warranty for most products sold on our platform is provided directly by the respective manufacturer or brand. Customers are encouraged to review the specific warranty terms and conditions, duration, and coverage details mentioned on the product page, the product packaging, or the warranty card included with the item. The typical warranty period for electronics, appliances, and certain durables ranges from 6 months to 2 years, varying by product and manufacturer.

ShopEase's direct responsibility for product defects or damages typically covers a limited 'return window,' often 7 days from delivery, for 'Damaged on Arrival' (DOA) or 'Defective on Arrival' claims. Beyond this initial window, any issues, malfunctions, or defects arising during the manufacturer's warranty period must be addressed directly with the manufacturer's authorized service center. Customers are required to retain their original ShopEase invoice and any warranty cards provided with the product, as these are mandatory for availing manufacturer warranty services.

Warranty coverage generally excludes damages caused by misuse, accidents, unauthorized repairs, liquid damage, physical abuse, power surges, or normal wear and tear. Consumable items (e.g., batteries, ink cartridges), personal care products, and digital goods typically come with limited or no manufacturer warranty, or are covered only for manufacturing defects upon arrival. ShopEase does not provide extended warranties or repair services directly. Any costs associated with shipping to a service center, if not covered by the manufacturer, are the customer's responsibility.

title: Damaged or Defective Product on Arrival (DOA) Claims Process
content:
This policy outlines the procedure for customers who receive a product that is either physically damaged or functionally defective immediately upon delivery. A 'Damaged on Arrival' (DOA) claim is valid if the product shows signs of damage (e.g., dents, scratches, broken parts) or is non-functional upon first inspection or use. Customers must report DOA claims within 48 hours of delivery for visible physical damage, and within 7 days of delivery for hidden functional defects. Reporting beyond these timelines may lead to claim rejection.

To initiate a DOA claim, the customer must contact ShopEase Customer Support with their order ID. For high-value items (₹5,000 and above) or products prone to external damage (e.g., televisions, laptops, fragile appliances), a complete and unedited 'unboxing video' demonstrating the damage or defect from the moment of package opening is mandatory. For other items, clear photographs of the damaged product, its packaging, and the shipping label are required. Our internal team will review the evidence. Depending on the product and type of damage, ShopEase may arrange a field executive visit for physical inspection or request remote troubleshooting assistance.

Upon successful verification of the DOA claim, ShopEase will arrange a free return pickup of the defective unit. The preferred resolution is a product replacement, subject to stock availability. If a replacement is not available, a full refund will be processed to the original payment method within 5-7 business days after the defective item is successfully returned to our warehouse. No additional charges will be incurred by the customer for valid DOA claims.

title: Post-Purchase Malfunction & Manufacturer Service Policy
content:
This document addresses situations where a product purchased from ShopEase malfunctions or develops a defect *after* the initial ShopEase return/replacement window (typically 7 days from delivery) but *within* the manufacturer's specified warranty period. In such cases, ShopEase's direct responsibility for returns or replacements ceases, and the customer must directly engage with the product manufacturer or their authorized service center for resolution.

To avail manufacturer warranty services, customers are required to present the original ShopEase invoice (which serves as proof of purchase and warranty activation date) and the product's warranty card (if applicable) to the service center. It is crucial for customers to retain these documents. Contact details for manufacturer service centers can usually be found on the product's packaging, the warranty card, the manufacturer's official website, or sometimes on the ShopEase product page under 'Warranty Information'.

ShopEase does not facilitate warranty repairs, provide loaner units, or bear any costs associated with transporting the product to and from a service center unless explicitly stated by the manufacturer. Warranty claims are subject to the manufacturer's terms, which typically exclude damages from physical impact, liquid spills, electrical fluctuations, unauthorized modifications, or consumable parts. For issues falling outside the manufacturer's warranty, service centers can provide repair estimates, and any repair costs will be the customer's responsibility. ShopEase's role is limited to providing necessary purchase documentation to assist the customer in their interaction with the manufacturer.

title: Customer-Initiated Order Cancellation (Pre-Shipment)
content:
This policy outlines the process for customers to cancel orders before they have been shipped from the seller's warehouse. 

**Eligibility for Cancellation:**
Customers can cancel an order only if its status is 'Order Placed' or 'Processing' and has not yet been marked as 'Shipped'. Once an order has been dispatched and marked 'Shipped', it cannot be cancelled directly. In such cases, customers must either refuse delivery or initiate a return request after receiving the product (refer to 'Cancellation After Shipment & Delivery Refusal Guidelines').

**How to Cancel:**
1.  Log in to the ShopEase account.
2.  Navigate to 'My Orders'.
3.  Select the specific order that needs to be cancelled.
4.  If eligible, a 'Cancel Order' button will be visible. Click on it.
5.  Select a reason for cancellation from the provided options (e.g., changed my mind, ordered by mistake, found a better price).
6.  Confirm the cancellation.

**Partial Order Cancellation:**
In certain scenarios, if an order contains multiple items from different sellers, customers may be able to cancel individual items before shipment. However, if all items are from the same seller and packed together, partial cancellation might not be available, requiring cancellation of the entire order.

**Refund Process for Prepaid Orders:**
For orders paid via credit card, debit card, UPI, NetBanking, or ShopEase Wallet, a full refund will be initiated immediately upon successful cancellation. The refund amount will be credited back to the original payment source.
*   **Bank/Card Payments:** Refunds typically reflect in the customer's account within 5-7 business days, depending on the bank's processing times.
*   **ShopEase Wallet:** Refunds are usually instant.

**Cash on Delivery (COD) Orders:**
For COD orders, no payment has been made, so no refund is required. The order will simply be cancelled.

**Impact on Customer Account:**
There are no penalties for customers who cancel orders prior to shipment. However, repeated cancellations of prepaid orders might be reviewed for unusual activity.

title: ShopEase-Initiated Order Cancellation Policy
content:
This policy details the circumstances under which ShopEase or its sellers may cancel an order, along with the corresponding notification and refund procedures.

**Reasons for ShopEase-Initiated Cancellation:**
ShopEase reserves the right to cancel an order under the following circumstances:
1.  **Item Out of Stock:** The product ordered is no longer available from the seller's inventory or cannot be sourced within a reasonable timeframe.
2.  **Payment Failure/Fraud:** The payment transaction failed, or there are suspicions of fraudulent activity associated with the order or payment method. This includes instances where payment is not received or verified.
3.  **Incorrect/Undeliverable Address:** The shipping address provided is incomplete, incorrect, or falls outside ShopEase's serviceable pin codes. Multiple failed delivery attempts due to an unreachable customer or incorrect details may also lead to cancellation.
4.  **Technical Glitch/Pricing Error:** In rare cases of a technical error leading to incorrect pricing or product listing, ShopEase may cancel the order to rectify the issue.
5.  **Seller-Specific Issues:** The seller is unable to fulfill the order due to internal operational issues, quality concerns, or non-compliance with ShopEase policies.
6.  **Violation of Terms & Conditions:** Any order placed in violation of ShopEase's Terms of Use (e.g., bulk purchase for resale, misuse of offers) may be cancelled.

**Notification to Customer:**
When an order is cancelled by ShopEase or the seller, the customer will be notified promptly via email and/or SMS, explaining the reason for the cancellation.

**Refund Process for Prepaid Orders:**
For all prepaid orders cancelled by ShopEase or the seller, a full refund will be automatically processed. The refund will be credited back to the original payment method used by the customer.
*   **Timeline:** Refunds typically reflect in the customer's bank account or card statement within 5-7 business days. ShopEase Wallet refunds are usually instant.
*   **No Deductions:** No cancellation or processing fees will be deducted from the customer's refund amount in such cases.

**Cash on Delivery (COD) Orders:**
If a COD order is cancelled by ShopEase, no payment has been exchanged, and therefore no refund is applicable. The order will simply be closed.

**Customer Recourse:**
If an order is cancelled due to stock unavailability, customers are encouraged to check the product page for updates on restock or similar alternatives. For address-related cancellations, customers should update their address details for future orders.

title: Cancellation After Shipment & Delivery Refusal Guidelines
content:
This policy clarifies the procedure and implications when a customer attempts to cancel an order after it has been shipped or refuses delivery.

**Policy on Post-Shipment Cancellation:**
Once an order has been marked 'Shipped' and is 'In Transit' with our logistics partner, it cannot be cancelled directly through the 'My Orders' section of the ShopEase platform. At this stage, the order is considered dispatched from the seller's warehouse and is en route for delivery.

**Customer Actions for Unwanted Shipped Orders:**
1.  **Refuse Delivery:** The preferred method for customers who no longer wish to receive a shipped order is to refuse acceptance of the package at the time of delivery. The delivery executive will mark the item as 'Refused' and it will be returned to the seller's warehouse.
2.  **Initiate a Return Request:** If the customer has accepted the delivery but wishes to return the product, they must initiate a return request via the 'My Orders' section on the ShopEase app or website within the eligible return window (e.g., 7 days for most electronics, 15 days for fashion items). This process falls under our standard Return Policy.

**Refund Process for Refused Deliveries (Prepaid Orders):**
For prepaid orders that are refused by the customer, a refund will be processed once the item is successfully received back at the seller's warehouse and a basic quality check (to ensure it's untampered) is completed. This typically takes longer than pre-shipment cancellations.
*   **Timeline:** Refunds for refused deliveries usually take 7-10 business days from the date the product is marked 'Returned to Origin' and reconciled at the warehouse.
*   The refund will be credited back to the original payment method.

**Refund Process for Refused Deliveries (COD Orders):**
For Cash on Delivery orders that are refused, no payment was made, so no refund is applicable. However, if a customer wishes to receive a refund for a COD order they accepted and then returned, the refund will be issued as ShopEase Wallet credit or via NEFT bank transfer, requiring the customer to provide their bank account details.

**Impact on Customer Account:**
While there is no direct penalty for refusing delivery, frequent or repeated refusals of prepaid orders might be flagged for review to understand unusual account activity. This is to ensure fair usage of our services and prevent potential misuse.

title: Standard Operating Procedure: Promo Code Application and Redemption Troubleshooting
content:
This document outlines the operational guidelines for ShopEase customer support representatives when assisting customers with coupon code application issues, validation errors, and discount redemption policy enforcement.

1. Coupon Types and Validation Rules
ShopEase offers three primary categories of promo codes:
- Platform Promo Codes (e.g., SHOPENEW100): Valid across all categories unless explicitly excluded in campaign terms.
- Category/Seller Specific Codes: Valid only on designated merchandise, specific brand stores, or participating sellers.
- Bank & Payment Gateway Instant Discounts: Applied directly at the payment checkout page, distinct from internal promo codes.

Key Rules:
- Minimum Order Value (MOV): Calculated purely on item cart value, excluding delivery charges, gift wrap, or handling fees. For instance, a coupon requiring an MOV of ₹499 will not trigger if the items total ₹470 plus ₹30 delivery fee.
- Non-Stackability: Unless explicitly designated as 'Stackable' in an active mega-sale campaign (e.g., Big Bachat Days), only one promo code can be applied per order.
- One-Time Use per Account/Device: Standard promo codes are restricted to one redemption per customer account, verified mobile number, and unique device ID.

2. Common Error Codes and Resolution Steps
- ERR_MOV_NOT_MET: Advise the customer to add eligible items to meet the required threshold (e.g., adding ₹29 worth of items to reach ₹499).
- ERR_COUPON_EXPIRED: Check campaign validity in the Admin Dashboard under Promotion Operations. If expired, agents cannot manually extend or re-generate codes.
- ERR_DEVICE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Triggered when multiple accounts use the same device ID to claim first-time user codes. Explain policy restrictions; do not override.

3. Escalation Process
If a customer meets all criteria (active campaign, valid MOV, correct category) but receives an internal server error (ERR_SYSTEM_PROMO_FAIL), support agents must raise an internal ticket to L2 Tech Operations via the CRM within 2 hours. Include the customer's User ID, Cart ID, and target Promo Code. L2 SLA for resolution is 24 business hours.

title: Refund Calculation and Coupon Re-issuance Policy for Cancelled and Returned Orders
content:
This policy details how refunds, partial refunds, and discount coupon re-issuances are handled by ShopEase when orders involving promotional discounts are cancelled or returned by the customer or seller.

1. Pro-Rata Discount Distribution
When a multi-item cart order utilizes a total basket discount coupon (e.g., ₹200 off on ₹1,000), the discount amount is distributed proportionally across all individual items based on their individual price weightage. 
Example: If Item A costs ₹600 and Item B costs ₹400 with a total coupon discount of ₹200, Item A receives a ₹120 discount (effective price ₹480) and Item B receives an ₹80 discount (effective price ₹320).

2. Refund Amounts for Returns & Cancellations
- Partial Order Cancellation/Return: If a customer returns or cancels an individual item from a multi-item order, the refund amount credited will be the net price paid for that specific item after pro-rata discount application. The full original value of the coupon is not refunded in cash or store credit.
- Full Order Cancellation: If the entire order is cancelled before dispatch, the total net amount paid by the customer is refunded to the original payment source within 3 to 5 business days for prepaid orders, or instantly to ShopEase Wallet.

3. Coupon Re-Issuance Rules
- Seller/Platform Cancellation: If an order is cancelled due to out-of-stock situations or seller logistics failure, any single-use promo code applied will be automatically re-issued to the customer's account within 24 hours, extending the original expiry date by 7 days.
- Customer-Initiated Cancellation: If the customer cancels an order post-dispatch or initiates a return after delivery, the promo code is considered fully consumed and will NOT be re-issued or restored to the customer's account under any circumstances.
- ShopCoins Redemption: ShopCoins used alongside promotional coupons will be refunded to the customer's reward balance within 4 hours of cancellation approval.

title: Terms and Operational Guidelines for First-User Offers and Referral Discounts
content:
This document defines the eligibility criteria, fraud prevention rules, and support workflows for ShopEase First-Time User discounts and the Customer Referral Rewards Program.

1. First-Time User Offers (WELCOME150 / FIRSTSHOP)
- Eligibility: Available exclusively to newly registered ShopEase accounts placing their very first order. The offer provides flat ₹150 off on a minimum order value of ₹599.
- Verification Parameters: To prevent misuse, the platform validates new user status using a combination of registered phone number, email address, delivery address, primary payment method, and hardware device fingerprint.
- Policy Rules: If an account attempts to place an order using a welcome code on a device where a previous ShopEase transaction was completed within the last 180 days, the system will auto-apply flag code RISK_DUPLICATE_USER and invalidate the discount.

2. Customer Referral Program (Refer & Earn)
- Referee Benefit: The referred friend receives a discount coupon of ₹100 off on their first purchase of minimum value ₹499.
- Referrer Reward: The existing user (referrer) earns 100 ShopCoins (equivalent to ₹100) per successful referral.
- Credit Timeline: Referrer rewards are placed in a 'Pending' status upon order placement and are credited to the referrer's ShopEase account strictly after the 7-day post-delivery return window for the referee's order has elapsed without any return requests.
- Cap Limits: A single user can earn referral rewards for a maximum of 10 successful referrals per calendar month (maximum ₹1,000 equivalent in ShopCoins).

3. Customer Support Handling for Missing Referral Credits
If a customer contacts support regarding uncredited referral rewards:
- Verify if the referee's order status is marked as 'Delivered' for more than 7 days.
- Confirm the referee did not initiate a replacement or return.
- Check if the monthly cap of 10 referrals was exceeded by the referrer.
- If all conditions are met but coins are not visible, trigger a manual reward reconciliation request in the Agent Admin Panel (SLA: 48 hours for credit reflect).

title: Standard Shipping Fees and Free Delivery Eligibility Policy
content:
This policy outlines the standard shipping fee structure, eligibility criteria for free delivery, and cash-on-delivery (COD) handling charges for orders placed on ShopEase.

1. Standard Delivery Charges & Order Thresholds
- Free Delivery Threshold: Orders with a net cart value of ₹499 or above (after applying discounts and coupons) qualify for Free Standard Delivery across all eligible pin codes in India.
- Standard Shipping Fee: Orders valued below ₹499 incur a non-refundable flat shipping charge of ₹40 per order, regardless of the number of items included in a single shipment.
- Fulfillment Sourcing: If an order contains items fulfilled by different third-party sellers, the delivery charge is calculated per seller cart subtotal unless the overall cart exceeds ₹499 under ShopEase Fulfilled listings.

2. Cash on Delivery (COD) Handling Fee
- A flat COD convenience fee of ₹29 applies to all Cash on Delivery orders, irrespective of total cart value or delivery location.
- The COD charge covers courier cash-handling operational costs and is strictly non-refundable in cases of customer-initiated returns post-delivery. However, if the order is canceled by ShopEase prior to dispatch, the full fee will be refunded.

3. Standard Delivery SLA Timelines
- Metro & Tier 1 Cities: 2 to 4 business days post-dispatch.
- Tier 2 & Tier 3 Cities: 4 to 7 business days post-dispatch.
- Rural & Deep-Interior Pin Codes: Up to 9 business days post-dispatch.

4. Order Split and Multi-Package Deliveries
If a single order containing multiple items is split into separate shipments due to inventory availability across different fulfillment centers, the customer will only be charged the delivery fee once at checkout. No additional charges will be levied for subsequent partial shipments.

title: ShopEase Express Delivery and Priority Shipping SLA Guidelines
content:
ShopEase provides expedited shipping options, including Same-Day Delivery and Next-Day Delivery, for select pin codes in Tier 1 and Metro cities (including Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi-NCR, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata, Pune, and Ahmedabad).

1. Express Shipping Fee Structure
- Same-Day Delivery (ShopEase Rush): Charged at a flat fee of ₹99 per shipment. Orders must be placed before the cutoff time of 11:00 AM IST to qualify for same-day arrival between 6:00 PM and 10:00 PM IST.
- Next-Day Delivery (ShopEase Express): Charged at a flat fee of ₹69 per shipment. Orders must be placed before the cutoff time of 6:00 PM IST for guaranteed delivery by 8:00 PM IST on the following calendar day.
- Free Shipping promotions, tier badges (e.g., ShopEase Club), and standard ₹499 cart thresholds do not apply toward Express Delivery charges unless explicitly stated during special promotional events.

2. Service Eligibility and System Validation
- Priority shipping availability is automatically validated at cart checkout based on customer pin code, stock location, and courier partner real-time SLA capacity.
- If an item in the cart is marked as ineligible for Express Shipping, the option will be disabled for the entire cart, or the customer may choose to split the shipment.

3. SLA Breach Delay Compensation Policy
- In the event that ShopEase fails to deliver an Express or Same-Day order within the promised timeframe due to internal logistics failure or carrier delay (excluding customer unavailability or natural disasters):
  a) The express delivery fee (₹69 or ₹99) will be fully refunded to the original payment method.
  b) An automated goodwill credit of ₹50 will be deposited into the customer's ShopEase Wallet within 24 hours of delayed delivery confirmation.

title: Remote Location Surcharges, Bulky Items, and Delivery Slot Policies
content:
This document specifies additional logistics fees applicable to specialized deliveries, including remote regional delivery surcharges, heavy or bulky goods handling fees, and scheduled slot delivery rules.

1. Regional Remote Location Surcharge (RLS)
- Shipments bound for designated high-cost or geographically difficult regions—including Jammu & Kashmir, Ladakh, Andaman & Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep, and select northeastern interior pin codes—are subject to a Remote Location Surcharge of ₹79 per order.
- The RLS fee is added over and above standard shipping rates and applies regardless of whether the cart value exceeds the ₹499 free delivery threshold.

2. Heavy and Bulky Items Shipping Fee
- Category Specifics: Large appliances (refrigerators, washing machines, TVs above 43 inches), heavy furniture, and fitness equipment weighing over 12 kg or exceeding specific volumetric dimensions.
- Freight Charge: A handling fee ranging between ₹199 and ₹499 per unit is levied based on weight brackets:
  a) 12 kg to 25 kg: ₹199
  b) 25 kg to 50 kg: ₹349
  c) Above 50 kg: ₹499
- Bulky item delivery charges are non-waivable and cover open-box delivery inspections where applicable.

3. Scheduled Slot Deliveries
- For large appliances and furniture, customers may select a delivery time slot (Morning: 9 AM-1 PM, Afternoon: 1 PM-5 PM, Evening: 5 PM-9 PM) during checkout for an additional fee of ₹49.
- Delivery Attempts Policy: Delivery partners will attempt delivery a maximum of 3 times. If delivery fails after 3 attempts due to customer unreachability or refusal without valid damage cause, the product returns to origin (RTO). The return freight fee (equivalent to the outbound delivery charge) will be deducted from the customer's final refund amount.

title: Stock Status Indicators and Cart Reservation Policy
content:
This policy details the operational definitions of stock badges visible on the ShopEase application and website, along with the automated cart reservation rules enforced across our Fulfillment Centers (FC-North Gurugram, FC-West Bhiwandi, and FC-South Bengaluru).

1. Stock Status Classifications:
- In Stock: Indicates that a minimum of 10 units are physically verified at the local FC servicing the customer's PIN code. Estimated delivery timelines range between 24 to 48 hours.
- Few Left in Stock: Displayed when local inventory drops below 10 units. Support agents must advise customers to complete purchase immediately, as stock reservation is not guaranteed prior to payment confirmation.
- Pre-Order: Applicable for select launches. Customers are charged the full item price (or a deposit of ₹199, depending on campaign terms). Expected dispatch dates are clearly listed on the Product Details Page (PDP).
- Out of Stock: Displayed when available units drop to zero across all regional fulfillment nodes.

2. Cart Reservation & Checkout Locking Rules:
- Items placed in the shopping cart are NOT reserved until the payment gateway process is initiated.
- Once a customer clicks 'Proceed to Pay', the system applies a hard lock on the unit for exactly 15 minutes. During this window, the stock counter decrements temporarily.
- If the transaction fails or remains incomplete after 15 minutes, the stock lock automatically releases back into the pool.

3. Regional Availability & PIN Code Mapping:
Product availability dynamically adjusts based on the delivery PIN code entered by the user. An item may show as 'In Stock' for a Mumbai PIN code (serviced by Bhiwandi FC) but 'Out of Stock' for a Patna PIN code if nearest nodes lack inventory. Support representatives should request the customer's 6-digit delivery PIN code before troubleshooting stock visibility issues.

title: Backorder Protocols and 'Notify Me' Queue Management
content:
This document outlines the operational procedures for managing customer restock alerts, high-demand product backorders, and seller cancellation compensations at ShopEase.

1. 'Notify Me' Automated Trigger Mechanism:
Customers who click 'Notify Me' on an out-of-stock PDP are entered into an automated communication queue handled by the ShopEase Communication Engine (SCE).
- Restock Alerts: Notifications via Push, SMS, and WhatsApp are triggered only when a seller or FC registers a stock replenishment of at least 5 units. If fewer than 5 units are added, notifications are withheld to prevent rapid stockouts and customer friction.
- Priority Allocation: Customers registered on ShopEase VIP (subscription tier) receive stock alerts 10 minutes prior to standard app users during mega-sale events such as Big Bachat Days.

2. Backorder Processing Rules:
Backorders are permissible only for verified Brand Authorised Sellers. When a backorder is placed:
- The estimated dispatch timeline is extended to 7–10 business days.
- The customer's card/UPI is charged at the time of order placement.
- Sellers failing to ship backordered stock within 10 business days face an automatic order cancellation triggered by the backend system.

3. Inventory Mismatch Compensation Policy:
If an accepted order is cancelled due to a seller inventory reporting error (e.g., phantom stock listing), the customer is entitled to automated redressal:
- A mandatory refund is processed within 2 hours to the original payment mode or instantly to ShopEase Wallet.
- An automated goodwill credit of ₹50 ShopEase Cash is issued to the customer's account, valid for 30 days on orders above ₹299.

title: Seller Inventory Mismatches and Auto-Cancellation Guidelines
content:
This reference guide instructs Customer Support specialists on managing order cancellations resulting from seller stock discrepancies, phantom listings, and fulfillment SLAs.

1. Seller Dispatch Timelines and SLAs:
Marketplace sellers on ShopEase are bound by strict fulfillment SLAs:
- Standard Sellers: Must hand over shipments to the logistics partner within 48 hours of order placement.
- Express Sellers: Must dispatch within 24 hours.

2. Automated Cancellation Triggers:
If a seller fails to update the shipment status to 'Handed Over to Logistics' within 72 hours of order creation, the ShopEase system automatically cancels the transaction under the error code 'ERR_SELLER_OUT_OF_STOCK'.

3. Refund Timelines for Stock Discrepancy Cancellations:
Upon system or agent-initiated cancellation due to non-availability of stock:
- ShopEase Wallet / ShopEase Pay Later: Instant credit (within 15 minutes).
- UPI / Instant Bank Transfers: 24 to 48 hours.
- Credit / Debit Cards / Net Banking: 3 to 5 business days depending on the acquiring bank.
- Cash on Delivery (COD) pre-authorizations: No monetary refund required as payment was not collected.

4. Seller Penalties & Escalation Path:
Support representatives should not manual-cancel orders unless requested by the customer. When a seller cancels an order due to zero stock:
- The seller is charged an inventory penalty equal to 5% of the product value or ₹100 (whichever is higher).
- If a seller accumulates three inventory-related cancellations within a rolling 30-day window, their product listing is suspended for audit by the Merchant Operations Team.

title: Standard 3-Tier Customer Support Escalation Matrix
content: The ShopEase Support Escalation Matrix defines the structured pathway for resolving customer queries that cannot be resolved at initial contact. Level 1 (L1) Support: Handled by Frontline Chat and Voice Agents. L1 agents are empowered to process immediate replacements, order cancellations, and instant wallet refunds up to ₹1,500 for missing or incorrect items. First Response Time (FRT) for chat is under 2 minutes, and standard email SLA is 24 hours. If an issue remains unresolved after 24 hours or requires higher financial override, it automatically escalates to Level 2. Level 2 (L2) Support: Managed by Team Leads and Senior Operations Specialists. L2 handles complex cases, logistics delays exceeding 5 business days, courier disputes, and refund overrides up to ₹15,000. L2 agents must conduct background audits with seller logistics partners within 48 hours of assignment. If the customer expresses extreme dissatisfaction, threatens legal action, or if the case exceeds ₹15,000, the ticket is transferred to Level 3. Level 3 (L3) Support & Grievance Office: Managed by the designated Grievance Officer in compliance with the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020. The Grievance Desk handles legal notices, consumer forum complaints, and high-value fraud inquiries. Acknowledgment must be sent to the customer within 48 hours, and final resolution provided within 15 working days. Escalation Path: Customers can manually request escalation by clicking 'Escalate Issue' in the ShopEase app after 48 hours of ticket creation. Support representatives must document all escalation reasons with specific tags (e.g., LOGISTICS_DELAY, BAD_SELLER_PACKAGING, REFUND_DISPUTE) to maintain strict audit compliance.

title: Escalation Policy for Open-Box Delivery Failures and Logistics Disputes
content: This policy governs escalations arising from Open-Box Delivery (OBD) failures, delivery agent misconduct, and post-delivery missing item reports for high-value purchases exceeding ₹2,000. Open-Box Delivery Dispute Process: When an OBD order (such as smartphones, laptops, or large appliances) is delivered, the courier partner must open the outer packaging in front of the customer. If the product is physically damaged, incorrect, or missing accessories, the customer must decline the delivery OTP. If the delivery agent forcibly marks the order as delivered without performing OBD, the customer must log a complaint within 48 hours via the ShopEase app. L1 agents must instantly trigger an internal OBD Dispute Ticket. Mandatory Evidence Collection: L1 agents must request outer box images, shipping label photos, and an unboxing video (if available) from the customer. The customer is given 72 hours to upload these documents via the link sent over SMS/WhatsApp. Escalation SLA & Logistics Audit: Once evidence is received, the ticket automatically escalates to the Logistics Escalations Desk. The team initiates an audit with the 3PL courier partner (e.g., Delhivery, Ecom Express, Ekart) within 24 hours. The courier must provide delivery agent geolocation logs and package weight audit metrics at the hub. Financial Remediation: If courier fault is established, ShopEase processes a full refund or free replacement within 3 business days. For claims involving amounts above ₹5,000, a mandatory seller chargeback of ₹499 administration fee is levied against non-compliant sellers who failed to secure package seals. Cases unresolved within 5 business days are directly escalated to the Operations Manager for emergency refund disbursement.

title: Handling Executive Office & National Consumer Helpline (NCH) Escalations
content: This document outlines the operational guidelines for handling escalations originating from external regulatory bodies, the National Consumer Helpline (NCH), consumer court notices, and direct communications to ShopEase Executive Leadership. NCH & INGRAM Portal Escalations: All complaints registered on the Integrated National Consumer Grievance Mechanism (INGRAM) portal are monitored by the Nodal Escalation Cell. Upon receiving an INGRAM docket number, the agent must cross-reference the customer's Registered Mobile Number (RMN) within 4 hours. Resolution must be uploaded to the INGRAM portal within 7 business days. Executive Office Escalations: Direct emails or letters addressed to the CEO or Executive Escalation Desk are managed by the High-Priority Resolution Team (HPRT). HPRT agents have an exclusive override authority up to ₹50,000 for customer goodwill gestures and instant settlements. A personal callback must be attempted within 24 hours of receiving an executive escalation. Inconvenience Compensation Guidelines: If an order delay exceeds 14 days due to ShopEase logistics failure or seller stock cancellation after payment confirmation, the customer is eligible for inconvenience compensation. Compensation tiers are structured as follows: ₹200 ShopEase Wallet credit for orders under ₹1,000; ₹500 wallet credit for orders between ₹1,001 and ₹5,000; and ₹1,000 wallet credit for orders above ₹5,000. Legal Notice Handling: Any formal legal notice received from a customer's legal counsel must be immediately forwarded to legal-escalations@shopease.in within 12 hours. Support agents must not provide written or verbal commitments regarding legal notices. The account status is flagged as 'Under Legal Review' until cleared by the ShopEase Legal Operations Team.
